rows.name: PYTHONPATH

problems.statement: The cell names only the code that sets the variable.
problems.code_says: `bin/extract_logits` always removes `PYTHONPATH` from the environment of its `uv run` child. `ingest/build-model.py` removes it when the export runs through `uv run`. A value that a developer sets does not reach these children. The label "Reads and sets" cannot show this.
The count holds: 8 files use the name in code. The house rules forbid a count of files. The cell also does not say which files remove the variable.

cells.Where: `flake.nix` (the Nix dev shell hook) reads and sets it. `GNUmakefile`, `nix/perfetto-config-schema.nix` and tests under `ingest/runtime/tests` set it for a Python command that they start. `bin/extract_logits`, `ingest/build-model.py` and `t/proxy/test_rzproxy.py` remove it for a child process.
cells.What Tron does with it: The Nix dev shell hook puts `ingest/runtime` and `ingest/export` of the checkout before the old value. `make test-ingest-python` and `make t_ingest_gemma3_rmsnorm_contract` set both directories for one Python command. `bin/extract_logits` and `ingest/build-model.py` remove it for their `uv run` child process.

evidence: flake.nix:559 - the shell hook exports `<root>/ingest/runtime:<root>/ingest/export` and then the old value, when both directories exist (line 558)
flake.nix:582 - the ingest shell takes the hook. Line 1844 passes it to the full dev shells through `inputsFrom`. Line 611 gives it to the shell `ingest-ci-toolchain`
GNUmakefile:945 - `test-ingest-python` sets `<checkout>/ingest/export:<checkout>/ingest/runtime` for the pytest command
GNUmakefile:1028 - `t_ingest_gemma3_rmsnorm_contract` sets the same value for one Python script

notes: All 12 rows are in section 7.4, so no row has a "For" label and no label doubt applies. No row had a hint. Facts: 11 rows graded correct, 1 row graded imprecise (`PYTHONPATH`). All 12 rows changed. House-rule changes: (1) 10 rows started "Where" with "Nothing in Tron." and now start with "No reader in Tron.". (2) Counts were removed: "and 2 more files" (`PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST`), "and 5 more files" (`PYTHONPATH`), "Two tests" (`PYTEST_ADDOPTS`, `PYTHONHASHSEED`), "two Nix builds" (`PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE`), and "One test" became "A test" (`PYTEST_PLUGINS`, `PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE`, `PYTHONIOENCODING`, `PYTHONUTF8`). (3) `PY_COLORS`: "colour" became "color", and the quoted pytest summary text `1 failed, 2 passed` was removed under the strict reading of rule 7. The text is in the source (t/proxy/test_rzproxy.py:3733). Restore it from the input file if rule 7 bans only test error texts. (4) `PYTEST_ADDOPTS`: the undefined term "replay run" was replaced by the fact that the tests assert, a nested `t/proxy/run_suite.sh` run with exit status 1. `PYTHONPATH`: the present row named only the code that sets the variable. `bin/extract_logits` (line 88) and `ingest/build-model.py` (line 440, only on the `uv run` path) remove it for their child process, so a value that a developer sets does not reach these children. The new "What Tron does with it" cell says so in 39 words. The new "Where" cell lists the files by action. The column "Tron" allows one of four labels, and three rows do more than their label says. Not changed, for a decision across the document: `PYTHONPATH` is "Reads and sets" and Tron also unsets it. `PYTEST_ADDOPTS` is "Sets" and `scrubbed_env` also unsets it. `PYTEST_PLUGINS` is "Unsets" and one test also sets it in its own process (t/proxy/test_rzproxy.py:2843). Not added: the fixture documents tell a person to set `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` when the person regenerates the tracked files (ingest/test/fixtures/query_rope/README.md:28). Side finding in the code, outside this file: the header comment of nix/tokenize-py.nix (line 3) says that the wrapper sets `PYTHONPATH`. The code sets `PATH` and `PYTHONNOUSERSITE` only (lines 18 and 19).
